universal_role: The immune-atlas card is the universal first-pass baseline that every customer IDAT runs through. It quantifies the patient's immune-class architectural state at the cellular level and routes the per-CpG profile to the disease signature matrix for downstream disease-card consumption. Every disease in the matrix is first detected via the immune system response, which makes this card the integration point for the entire disease constellation: the universal screen, the per-cell-type fanout, the inflammaging quantum, the personal Cosmic Microwave Methylome, and the Stage 8 three-route engine that hands findings to downstream disease cards. The immune-atlas card produces no disease verdict — disease names appear only on per-disease cards and per-disease website pages, never in the immune-class readout itself.

stage_2_dual_deconvolution.doctrine: Two mathematically independent deconvolvers run every time. Cross-method confirmation is what Planck used to validate CMB temperature maps (Commander/NILC/SMICA/SEVEM all had to agree); CPG inherits the same discipline. Disagreement between deconvolvers IS diagnostic information — surfaced, not averaged away.

primary_deconvolver.name: Walther IAM Deconvolver
primary_deconvolver.algorithm: Non-Negative Least Squares (NNLS) with simplex constraint (Σf=1, f≥0); class-level solve first, then per-cell-type refinement

output_per_patient.per_class_ci: 95% CI propagated from atlas MCMC posterior SDs via Monte Carlo (1000 draws from per-CpG posteriors)
output_per_patient.marker_coverage: fraction of marker substrate observed in patient β

secondary_deconvolver.name: NILC Deconvolver (Needlet Internal Linear Combination)
secondary_deconvolver.algorithm: Generalized least squares with inverse-variance weighting (W=diag(1/σ²)) using per-CpG posterior SDs from the IAMAtlas posterior. No non-negativity constraint imposed during solve; simplex projection applied post-hoc. Mathematically independent from Walther NNLS.
secondary_deconvolver.rationale: Derived from Planck's NILC methodology applied to the methylome. The two deconvolvers are derived from different optimization frameworks (Walther: constrained optimization via NNLS; NILC: variance-weighted least squares). Disagreement reveals β-profile structure neither captures cleanly, surfacing patient-specific peculiarity.
secondary_deconvolver.output_per_patient: Independent per-class fraction estimate + per-CpG residual variance

cross_method_gate.outlier_patient_rule: Any patient with per-class disagreement > 0.20 on >= 2 classes is flagged CROSS_METHOD_DISAGREEMENT; downstream Stage 5+ outputs carry a confidence-reduction flag; the report includes a cross-method-gate warning.

stage_3_foreground_subtraction.doctrine: Empirical foreground subtraction is a SUPPORT tool. The architectural A-score H(β_mean)/H_min IS the physics. When a foreground layer doesn't transfer across cohorts (a real risk for linear-coefficient layers fit on one population), the physics-correct response is to run on raw β and let the architecture speak — not pivot to better regression. Foreground subtraction REDUCES noise from known confounders when it transfers cleanly, never compromises the physics readout.

stage_6_cellular_age.doctrine_recipe_6_3: For each architectural class: compute β_mean = mean of patient's β over that class's marker CpGs. Invert the baseline's (decade → β_mean) curve to find the age at which baseline β_mean equals patient β_mean. That's the per-class cellular age. No training. No regression. The baseline IS the instrument; the patient's β_mean IS the measurement; the cellular age IS the readback.
stage_6_cellular_age.monotonicity_note: β_mean DECREASES with age in healthy reference per Recipe §6.3 line 1900. Patient β_mean above youngest decade → SATURATED_HIGH (assign youngest age). Patient β_mean below oldest decade → SATURATED_LOW.

grouping_rationale.B_cell_lineage_separated: B-lineage compartments diverge in different malignancies (multiple myeloma drives plasma cell clonal expansion while general B-cell stays normal; DLBCL drives B-cell expansion while plasma cells stay normal — opposite-direction patterns at the same lineage).
grouping_rationale.naive_CD4_vs_CD8_separated: HIV selectively depletes CD4 (gp120-CD4 binding) while sparing naive CD8 — opposite-direction pattern within the same lineage.
grouping_rationale.memory_T_cells_pooled: CD4mem + CD8mem aggregate is the right granularity for inflammaging and chronic viral memory inflation (CMV, EBV) signatures.
grouping_rationale.macrophage_subtypes_separated: Microglia (CNS-resident, behind blood-brain barrier) and Kupffer cells (liver-resident) diverge from peripheral macrophages in neurodegenerative and hepatic disease — opposite-direction patterns at the same lineage.
grouping_rationale.dendritic_cells_standalone: Antigen-presenter bridge between innate and adaptive; cardiovascular and tumor microenvironment signatures distinct from monocyte lineage.

disease_immune_lens.doctrine: The disease_immune_lens is the JSON-formatted, immune-class-perspective index of the disease signature matrix v1.8. Every disease the framework can detect is first detected via the immune system response — this lens names them. The matrix is the authoritative source for cell-level Cohen's d values; this lens provides the per-disease immune-perspective summary, the immune cells most informative for each disease, and the matrix row pointer. Disease names appear here for engine consumption and clinician reading — NEVER in the customer-facing immune-class readout.
disease_immune_lens.design_principle: Design C (hybrid) per Heath's 2026-06-07 direction — compact disease index from immune perspective; authoritative numeric data stays in the matrix, lens avoids data duplication.

disease_immune_lens.cells_firing_threshold: Per-cell Cohen's |d| >= 0.20 included in immune_cells_most_informative list (lower-magnitude signals visible in matrix v1.8 source)
disease_immune_lens.heme_card_note: Heme cancers (AML, CML, MDS, MPN, B-ALL, T-ALL, DLBCL, CLL, multiple myeloma, thymoma) appear here as disease-index entries; the heme-immune card owns the disease-specific deep clinical detail.

entries.immune_perspective: Pre-diagnostic immune-class signal distributed across multiple cells 10+ years before clinical breast cancer diagnosis (eosinophils, regulatory T cells, naive B cells co-elevated); the immune system response is the EARLIEST detectable signal of breast cancer and is consistently strongest at long pre-dx windows then attenuates as diagnosis approaches.
Distributed immune-class signal persists at mid-pre-dx window but at attenuated magnitude vs long-pre-dx; the long-pre-dx signature pattern is weakening as the disease approaches clinical detection.
Continued attenuation of the distributed immune-class signal at the mid-to-late pre-dx window; trajectory direction matters more than single-time-point magnitude.

Compartment transition — naive B cell elevation appears at 0-2 years before clinical breast cancer diagnosis; the long-pre-dx regulatory T cell signal attenuates; immune-tile sign reversal is characteristic of the immediate-pre-clinical phase.
At clinical breast cancer diagnosis, the immune-class signal quiets while the breast tile (cycling/secretory class) dominates; same disease arc, different phase.

Post-IAMAtlas-build re-validation — broad architectural disturbance with universal Mahalanobis at d=+1.876/+2.097 across two EPIC-Italy cohorts (CPG-VAL-002); 1,392 concordant CpG residual map (CPG-VAL-003); the universal architectural metric outperforms the prior disease-trained panel by d=+0.75 (panel identity in pre_build_audit_lineage).
In tumor tissue (research substrate), immune-class signal aggregates with the secretory-class tile elevation; not the surveillance pathway.

Pre-diagnostic blood signal INVERSION — colorectal cancer reads with immune-class signal NEGATIVE (suppressed) in pre-diagnostic blood, opposite of breast/lung. The tumor-infiltrating immune compartment shows positive signal in tumor tissue (research only) — compartment-flip pattern.
Continued immune-class signal inversion at mid-pre-dx; pattern stays SUPPRESSED in peripheral blood throughout the pre-diagnostic window.
Continued immune-class signal inversion approaching diagnosis; SUPPRESSED tier reading in patients with CRC family history warrants discussion.
Immune-class signal stays inverted (SUPPRESSED) into the near-diagnostic window.
At diagnosis, compartment flip — peripheral immune still suppressed while tumor compartment shows positive immune infiltration.
Tumor tissue (research substrate) shows positive immune infiltration (CD4 and CD8 expansion); peripheral blood remains suppressed — the CRC three-compartment signature.
Pre-malignant signal flagged O5 data integrity (CCL-040); interpretation deferred pending cohort review.
Pooled positive immune-class signal in pre-diagnostic lung cancer cohorts; smoking status is a MANDATORY covariate because tobacco-driven methylation co-occurs with malignancy-driven methylation.
Largest paired immune effect in the tumor-tissue cookbook (d=+1.020 universal; d=+1.283 in ever-smoker stratum); neutrophil expansion characteristic of NSCLC tumor microenvironment.

Pooled-entropy NULL with directional panel recovery — the universal alarm cancels in pre-diagnostic pancreatic cancer due to bidirectional firing, but the AD-style directional panel recovers signal cleanly (n=7 paired d=+1.51 on TCGA-PAAD holdout).
Continued bidirectional-cancellation pattern; trajectory monitoring is essential.
Tumor tissue shows the bidirectional pattern; pancreatic exocrine + endocrine secretory tiles diverge.

Pooled-positive balanced bidirectional firing in prostate cancer at diagnosis; monocyte expansion + LE (luminal epithelial) tile depression — the 5-vs-1 direction split is the prostate cancer signature.
Cell-of-origin (LE luminal epithelial) NEGATIVE while tumor microenvironment immune cells (CD4/CD8/B/NK monocytes) all POSITIVE — characteristic compartment divergence.

Substrate-restricted to plasma cfDNA — HCC immune signal detectable in plasma cfDNA at pre-malignant fibrosis stage; whole-blood substrate NULL. Monotonic dose-response healthy → fibrosis → cirrhosis → HCC.
Substrate-restricted plasma cfDNA signal escalates at cirrhosis stage; Kupffer cell signature elevates with hepatic inflammation.
Active HCC immune-class signal d=+0.634 on plasma cfDNA (Nigerian HIV+ cohort); whole-blood NULL. Plasma cfDNA is the optional add-on substrate for HCC monitoring.

Kupffer cells DEPLETE in advanced HCC while peripheral macrophages (tumor-associated macrophages within the tumor) ELEVATE — opposite direction in the same patient. Non-viral HCC (alcohol/NAFLD) shows stronger paired-tissue signal than viral HCC.

Advanced gastric cancer in tumor tissue — T cells DEPLETED (CD4 and CD8 both DOWN), B cells preserved (B-cell-rich pattern in advanced cohorts). Active gastritis shows the opposite (T cells UP, neutrophils UP).
ESCC squamous cell carcinoma — within-cohort Stage 1 d=+2.644; cell-of-origin retention signature in squamous tissue.
EAC adenocarcinoma — within-cohort Stage 1 d=+3.703 (strongest in gastric/eso sprint); cell-of-origin signature LOST (homogenized methylation pattern).
Pre-malignant Barrett's esophagus — within-cohort Barrett-positive subset d=+4.50, +1.69 d-units above Barrett-negative.
Pre-malignant CIN3 — pooled-positive immune signal HPV-stratified; HPV status drives healthy-baseline differences; HPV-negative comparator vs HPV-positive baseline gives different Cohen's d values.
Active cervical cancer in tumor tissue — pooled positive with HPV stratification; cervical cycling epithelium dominates.
Loudest immune-class red flag in the cookbook — paired Stage 1 d=+1.90; broad TIL+TAM+MDSC tumor microenvironment infiltration (6/6 immune tiles fire POSITIVE, |d| range 0.49-1.24).
Predicted positive (cycling-class moderate, d~+0.30 to +0.50); kidney-epic card v0.1 in development.

Low-grade glioma — Stage 1 immune blood d=+1.25 pre-surgery (LARGER than GBM in same cohort); cortical-neuron Stage 2 cfDNA fraction d=+1.96 through blood-brain-barrier disruption. The lower-grade tumor produces a louder Stage 1 immune signal than the higher-grade tumor.

Glioblastoma — Stage 1 immune blood d=+0.80 pre-surgery (quieter than LGG); cortical-neuron cfDNA d=+1.96 from BBB disruption. Higher-grade tumor is already farther into post-commitment dedifferentiation.
GBM tumor tissue — terminal-class displacement; cortical-neuron fraction at 39.3% vs 62.4% non-tumor brain (d=-2.81).
CHIP (Clonal Hematopoiesis of Indeterminate Potential) — pooled-positive clonal expansion signature at the HSC/myeloid progenitor stage; serial CHIP-to-AML trajectory is a research priority.

Active AML — immune class IS the diseased tissue. Methyl-only single-substrate buffy-coat ΔA=+0.10 absolute (d=+3.71 STRONGEST single-cohort effect in cookbook). Broad immune-class compositional shifts reflect clonal expansion at the GMP stage with neutrophil-dominant pattern.
CML — BCR::ABL1-driven; neutrophils + monocytes + myeloid progenitors expanded; disease lives in the readout compartment.
MDS — dyserythropoiesis (erythroid downstream DEPLETED), myeloid progenitors UP; ~30% transform to AML.
MPN — lineage-specific expansion (polycythemia vera erythroid UP; essential thrombocythemia megakaryocyte UP; primary myelofibrosis).
B-ALL — pooled positive B-cell + lymphoid progenitor expansion; mostly pediatric.
T-ALL — pooled positive CD4 + CD8 + lymphoid progenitor expansion; mostly pediatric.

DLBCL — the largest immune-class ΔA in the cookbook (A≈1.13 ΔA=+0.203, Chapuy 2018 n=48). B cell expansion strongly (d=+1.5 to +2.5); plasma cells typically NORMAL (distinguishes from multiple myeloma); quieter T-cell.

CLL pre-diagnostic (CCL-064 EnviroGenomarkers Georgiadis 2017 anchor) — 28 future-CLL of n=347 with samples 2-15.7 years before diagnosis; A≈1.07 ΔA=+0.098. Closest pre-diagnostic anchor in cookbook to breast-epic VAL-047 10-year window.
Active CLL — B cells UP, memory B cells UP, T cells quiet.
Thymoma — T-cell expansion (often CD8) at d=+1.0 to +2.0; CD4/CD8 ratio inversion characteristic. Stage 3 T-cell-dominant shift routes to chest imaging differential.
MGUS / smoldering myeloma — plasma cell signal elevation BEFORE overt malignancy. The earliest pre-malignant signal in the cookbook.

Active multiple myeloma — plasma cells UP (clonal expansion at d=+1.5/+3.0) while general B cells stay normal or DOWN. Opposite direction from B-cell lymphomas — clonal plasma expansion replaces normal B-cell diversity.

Pre-symptomatic AD — pooled-entropy NULL with directional 7-CpG Rule A panel recovery (d=+0.62 on AIBL holdout, d=+0.33 on AddNeuroMed cross-platform). The universal alarm cancels due to bidirectional firing; directional panel surfaces the signal.

Active AD — A_immune fires with disease-specific direction (CPG-VAL-016 d=-0.364); microglia activation around amyloid plaques (CNS-resident); cortical-neuron cfDNA <0.5% with AD anchor 0.25% (vs glioma anchor 1.09%). The glioma-vs-AD differential flag fires when cortical-neuron > 0.5%.

Active FTD — pooled-entropy NULL with per-CpG partial preservation; Stage 1 immune signal preserves 5/7 frozen directions per VAL-057 — suggesting tauopathy-associated drift co-detection with the AD directional panel.
Active PSP/CBD — directional panel partial preservation; PSP/CBD reads BELOW HC in some cohorts (architectural compaction direction).

Pulmonary arterial hypertension — vascular endothelial cells elevation (d=+0.79 hPAH); concurrent cardiac stroma elevation (heart-tissue calibration cohort d=+1.42); Stage 1 immune at d=+0.65 in cultured PEC substrate. hPAH > iPAH framework signal.

BAV with aortic dissection — macrophage elevation (d=+1.40 to +1.61); dendritic cell elevation; fibroblast elevation; endothelial elevation; Stage 1 immune at d=+1.08 BAV vs +0.56 dissection. Substrate-distribution-mismatch flag for bulk aorta tiles.

Ischemic stroke — biology-correct NULL on whole blood. Post-stroke systemic inflammatory response homogenizes the immune signature; whole-blood DNA methylation does not stratify ischemic stroke by TOAST etiology at array resolution.

Active Crohn's disease — population-fraction T-up / myeloid-down shift. Broad T cell expansion (CD4 d=+1.64 to +1.66, CD8 d=+1.70, naive CD8 d=+1.72); neutrophil DEPRESSION (d=-1.34). The T-up/myeloid-down pattern is the IBD signature distinct from cancer.
Active ulcerative colitis — similar T-up/myeloid-down pattern as Crohn's, with disease-specific magnitude variations.

Active rheumatoid arthritis — pooled-positive autoantibody-lineage expansion. Memory B cell expansion (chronic-autoreactive-antibody-producing repertoire); regulatory T cell shifts; plasma cell expansion in established RA.
Active SLE — pooled-positive autoantibody-lineage expansion. Memory B cell expansion; plasma cell expansion (autoantibody production); naive B cell variable.
Active MS — pooled-positive CNS-resident inflammation. Microglia activation in CNS (demyelinating lesions); peripheral T cell shifts; memory B cell expansion documented.
Active psoriasis — pooled-positive T-cell skin-hyperproliferation signature; T cell shifts + regulatory T cell variations.
Active Parkinson's — placeholder clinical literature; microglia activation in substantia nigra documented; peripheral immune signature less characterized at v2.0.
Active ALS — placeholder clinical literature; microglia activation along motor neuron tracts documented; peripheral immune signature characterized at the class-pattern level.
Active schizophrenia — placeholder; no canonical immune-class signature established at v2.0.
Active major depression — placeholder; no canonical immune-class signature established at v2.0.
Chronic HIV — lineage-specific CD4 depletion. Naive CD4 T cells DEPLETED (HIV selectively targets CD4 lineage via gp120-CD4 binding); naive CD8 less affected — opposite-direction pattern.
Chronic HBV/HCV — pooled positive with HCC pre-malignant progression risk; plasma cell expansion (sustained antibody production); Kupffer cell signal elevation (liver inflammation).
Chronic CMV — memory inflation lineage skew. Memory T cell expansion (CD8mem strongly, CD4mem moderately) — the canonical memory inflation signature.
Chronic EBV — memory inflation lineage skew. Memory B cell expansion + memory T cell expansion.

Recent vaccination (within 6 weeks) — context-driven, resolves. Naive B cell expansion (encounter-driven activation); plasma cell expansion (antibody production); memory B cell expansion (memory formation); T helper cell shifts. Normal vaccine response biology, not pathology.
Recent bacterial infection — context-driven, resolves. Neutrophil expansion characteristic; resolves over weeks.

Recent viral infection (including common cold, flu, COVID-19) — context-driven, resolves. T cell expansion (viral); pattern depends on pathogen class; resolves over weeks. The single most common cause of transient elevated immune-class signal in healthy customers.
Active allergies (in season) — context-driven, resolves with allergen exposure ending. Eosinophil elevation; basophil shifts; IgE-related pattern.

Pregnancy — context_DECLINED scoring. Immune compartment shifts toward tolerance (regulatory T cells UP, certain effector subsets DOWN). v2.0 DECLINES scoring during pregnancy because the baseline reference distribution does not include pregnancy-state customers.
Active chemotherapy — expected suppression, declared treatment context. Broad immune compartment SUPPRESSION expected; engine uses EXPECTED_SUPPRESSION mode for declared treatment contexts.

Normal aging — chronological drift; thymic involution drives naive T cell decline; memory T cell accumulation; gradual broad immune-class shifts. Normal aging does NOT reach disease-tier thresholds — A-score reaches cancer threshold only after ~1,075 years of normal-aging-rate drift per CPG-VAL-006/015/020 anchors.

Inflammaging — uniform immune elevation with no lineage skew. Pooled cross-cohort r=+0.034 NULL informative (CPG-VAL-017) due to cohort heterogeneity; within-cohort late-life acceleration ratio 2.19 (post-70 slope 2.2x steeper than pre-50); decade-medians show late-life-specific decline (60s peak 0.792, 80s 0.766).

At-diagnosis AD post-build — directional panel dominant + architectural compaction; CPG-VAL-014 GIFT AD d=+0.681; CPG-VAL-019 AIBL bidirectional d_up=+0.494 / d_down=-0.515; CPG-VAL-011 stem_adult age-subtraction reveals d=-0.190 (from -0.004).
Post-build FTD on GIFT 2026 — weak immune negative drift; tauopathy class. CPG-VAL-014 FTD d=+0.279 (p=0.108 non-significant); intermediate between AD positive and PSP negative directions.

Post-build PSP/CBD on GIFT 2026 — broad negative drift; architectural compaction. CPG-VAL-014 PSP d=-0.380 (p=0.034); confirms v2.2 BELOW_NORMAL tier directly via universal hyper-volume metric. Three-direction tauopathy differential: AD positive / FTD intermediate / PSP negative.

wellness_aging_inflammation_lens.doctrine: The immune system tells us things beyond discrete diseases. The disease_immune_lens covers what the immune-class signal looks like for each named disease in the matrix v1.8. This lens covers everything else: aging trajectory, inflammaging burden, lifestyle factors that shift the immune baseline, acute response contexts (illness, vaccination), life-stage hormonal changes, treatment contexts that drive expected suppression, environmental exposures, and the cross-disease universal alarm signatures. The categories below are how the framework reads non-disease immune state — most customers most of the time live in these patterns, not in disease signatures.

healthy_aging_trajectory.description: Chronological methylation drift — the immune A-score declines monotonically with age across general-population cohorts (Hannum r=-0.197, Han Chinese r=-0.142, Tsaprouni r=-0.056). Naive T cell decline (thymic involution) + memory T cell accumulation are the canonical immune-aging biomarkers.
healthy_aging_trajectory.validation_anchor: CPG-VAL-015 PASS (A_immune r=-0.197 p=3.69e-07 Hannum n=656; sex-symmetric; decade-median Spearman rho=-0.854) + CPG-VAL-020 full-chain reproduction (chain integrity 656/656, physics-layer A_immune r=-0.184 p=1.97e-06)
healthy_aging_trajectory.magnitude_calibration: A-score reaches cancer-tier threshold only after ~1,075 years of normal-aging-rate drift — normal aging does NOT cross disease tiers (CPG-VAL-006 / VAL-020 anchor).

inflammaging_burden.description: Late-life acceleration of immune-class methylation drift — within-cohort ratio 2.19 (post-70 slope 2.2x steeper than pre-50, in the opposite direction). Pooled cross-cohort regression FAILS because of cohort recruitment heterogeneity (case-control HC arms over-represent survivor selection) but the late-life-specific decline is unambiguous in decade-medians.
inflammaging_burden.validation_anchor: CPG-VAL-017 NULL informative (pooled r=+0.034 p=0.150 washed by heterogeneity; within-cohort late-life acceleration ratio 2.19; decade-medians show late-life-specific decline 60s peak 0.792 -> 80s 0.766)
inflammaging_burden.lesson: Pooled fixed-effects regression is the wrong test when cohorts have heterogeneous recruitment frames. Mixed-effects with cohort random effect is the correct test (queued for CPG-VAL-017_v2).

cellular_age_delta_interpretation.description: The headline metric — immune cellular age minus chronological age. Positive delta = immune system reads OLDER than chronological (inflammaging quantum positive); negative delta = immune system reads YOUNGER than chronological (rare; chemo/cytoreduction artifact or chronological-age intake error). Saturation flags (SAT_HIGH / SAT_LOW) when patient is outside the age reference matrix range (4-95 years).

smoking_active.description: Current smoking drives chronic immune-class methylation drift via AHRR cg05575921 + ~100 cataloged tobacco-CpGs. Current_smoker bin carries residual tobacco signal absorbed into the immune A-score in v2.0 (Stage 3 smoking-axis foreground subtraction script is v1.1 deferred). Stage 7 threshold uplift partially mitigates.
smoking_active.evidence_anchor: CPG-VAL-022 NULL informative (Tsaprouni n=464, smoking effect d=+0.11 BELOW detection threshold with n=22 current; cohort-limitation null, not framework falsification)
smoking_active.stage_7_handling: smoking_bin (never / current / quit_0-5y / quit_5-15y / quit_15+y) drives threshold stratification

smoking_post_cessation_persistence.description: Former smokers OVERSHOOT past never-smoker baseline in some cohorts (Tsaprouni former mean 0.831 vs current 0.828 vs never 0.825) — NOT simple intermediate as reversibility would predict. Persistent post-cessation immune-class methylation marks track tobacco exposure with ~10-year half-life (AHRR cg05575921 well-validated); F2RL3 cg03636183 is a second well-validated tobacco-driven site. Only stem_adult class shows true reversibility (Tsaprouni ratio 0.66).
smoking_post_cessation_persistence.evidence_anchor: CPG-VAL-022 + literature (McCarthy 2017, Joehanes 2016, Annibali 2019, van der Plaat 2018)

alcohol_use.description: Regular alcohol use shifts immune-class methylation in cohort-stratified ways; cumulative exposure tracks with hepatic and CNS class drift. Literature anchor; no dedicated CPG-VAL.

sleep_quality_and_duration.description: The strongest single modifiable factor for immune health. Chronic sleep restriction drives inflammaging-pattern shifts; recovery from improved sleep typically observable in CPG re-test at 8-12 weeks. Literature anchor; no dedicated CPG-VAL.
sleep_quality_and_duration.evidence_anchor: literature_anchors.json (sleep entries — Irwin lab + AASM cohorts)

chronic_stress.description: Cortisol-driven chronic-stress immune compartment shifts; observable in regulatory T cell, memory B cell, and inflammatory neutrophil patterns. Recovery via stress-management interventions typically observable in 12-24 weeks. Literature anchor.

exercise_regular.description: Beneficial methylation patterns; exercise drives reductions in inflammatory cell-fraction signatures (neutrophil-to-lymphocyte normalization). Literature anchor.

nutrition.description: Specific dietary patterns (Mediterranean, plant-forward) associated with favorable immune methylation; the literature is heterogeneous on specific food-level claims. Customer-facing guidance grounded in well-established cohort findings only.

common_cold_and_other_recent_viral_infec.description: Common cold (rhinovirus, coronaviruses, RSV), flu, COVID-19 — recent viral infection drives transient immune-class elevation via T cell expansion (viral pattern); typically resolves over 4-12 weeks. The single most common cause of transient elevated immune-class signal in healthy customers. CPG declines to interpret single readings within 6 weeks of declared recent illness.

recent_bacterial_infection.description: Bacterial infection (UTI, strep, pneumonia, gum disease flare) drives neutrophil-dominant immune-class elevation; resolves over 4-8 weeks post-recovery.

recent_vaccination.description: Vaccine response (within 6 weeks) drives naive B cell expansion + plasma cell expansion + memory B cell expansion + T helper cell shifts. This is NORMAL vaccine response biology, not pathology. CPG flags recent vaccination at intake and applies Stage 7 floor uplift.

active_allergies_in_season.description: Eosinophil elevation + basophil shifts + IgE-related pattern; resolves with allergen exposure ending. Customer-declared seasonal-allergy context contextualizes the eosinophil tile elevation.

recent_surgery_or_acute_inflammation_epi.description: Post-surgical acute-phase response drives broad immune-class elevation for 6-12 weeks. Engine flags recent_surgery at intake and applies suppression-of-interpretation window.

pregnancy.description: Immune compartment shifts toward tolerance (regulatory T cells UP, certain effector subsets DOWN). v2.0 DECLINES scoring during pregnancy — the baseline reference distribution does not include pregnancy-state customers. Post-partum return to baseline typically 6-12 months.
pregnancy.stage_7_handling: current_pregnancy=any_trimester -> ELEVATED floor 1.04->1.06 (when scoring is performed despite pregnancy flag)

menopause_and_post_menopause.description: Hormonal shifts post-menopause drive immune-class baseline changes; HRT status modulates these. CPG captures menopause_status + HRT_status at intake but applies no Stage 7 override at v2.0 (literature evidence pending).

menarche_age_effect.description: Tested in CPG-VAL-018 as a natural-experiment variable in female immune architecture — clean NULL (partial r=+0.010 p=0.82, magnitude 10x below pre-registered threshold). Menarche-age range restriction (9-17) and adult-age sampling (34-72) limit power; framework's broader reproductive-endocrinology claim is NOT falsified, only this specific proxy.

puberty_and_pediatric_immune_baseline.description: Pediatric (<18) immune baselines are NOT in v2.0 calibration cohort (age range validated 18-95). Pediatric customers receive INSUFFICIENT_AGE_CALIBRATION flag with age-calibration disclaimer.

chronic_conditions_affecting_baseline.doctrine: These chronic conditions shift the immune-class baseline persistently. Customer-declared status at intake triggers Stage 7 covariate overrides + report context. Disease-specific signatures live in disease_immune_lens (see matrix v1.8 row pointers).

chronic_hiv.stage_7_handling: hiv_status=positive_treated -> ELEVATED floor 1.07->1.10 (treated HIV chronic-immune-activation baseline)

autoimmune_chronic.matrix_pointer: matrix v1.8 rows 59-62 (RA, SLE, MS, psoriasis)

chronic_viral_persistence_cmv_ebv.description: CMV and EBV chronic carriage drive memory inflation lineage skew. Most adults carry CMV and EBV; customer baseline reflects this background carriage. No specific Stage 7 override but engine flags memory-inflation pattern.

chronic_hepatitis_bc.stage_7_handling: Engine flags chronic hepatitis at intake; downstream HCC card consumed if pre-malignant fibrosis/cirrhosis declared

active_chemotherapy.description: Broad immune compartment SUPPRESSION expected. Engine uses EXPECTED_SUPPRESSION mode. Not a pathology signal — declared treatment context drives the SUPPRESSED reading.

immunosuppression_medications.description: Immunosuppressive medications (tacrolimus, cyclosporine, methotrexate, biologic monoclonals) drive expected suppression. Customer-declared at intake; SUPPRESSED tier is intended treatment effect.

recent_transplant_solid_organ_or_bm.description: Post-transplant adaptive state — broad immune compartment in transitional state for 6-24 months post-transplant. Customer-declared at intake.
recent_transplant_solid_organ_or_bm.stage_7_handling: transplant_status=recent_bm OR recent_solid_organ -> ELEVATED floor 1.07->1.10 (post-transplant adaptive state)

active_radiation_therapy.description: Local radiation does not typically drive systemic immune-class signal at the magnitudes seen for chemo; total body irradiation pre-BMT is the exception (treated under transplant_status).

air_pollution_chronic.description: Chronic exposure to PM2.5/diesel exhaust/wildfire smoke drives sustained inflammatory immune-class methylation shifts. Literature anchor.

persistent_low_grade_infections.description: Common silent drivers of immune-class elevation — periodontal disease (gum disease), chronic sinusitis, untreated UTI, H. pylori carriage, untreated dental abscess. Addressing these often shows up in CPG re-test as immune-class normalization within 12-24 weeks.

occupational_chemical_exposure.description: Heavy metals, organic solvents, pesticides — drive cohort-specific methylation patterns; CPG flags occupational exposure at intake for transparency, no Stage 7 override at v2.0.

universal_alarm_signatures.doctrine: These are immune-class patterns that fire across multiple diseases as PRE-CLINICAL signals — the immune system has detected something but the disease signature hasn't yet specialized to a specific tile.

cross_disease_universal_alarm.description: A_immune fires across multiple diseases with disease-specific direction (AD hypomethylates, breast pre-dx hypermethylates). The universal alarm signal is real and disease-specific in direction — pooled (sign-aligned) tests CANCEL the signal informatively.
cross_disease_universal_alarm.validation_anchor: CPG-VAL-016 DIRECTIONAL (AD d=-0.36, breast pre-dx d=+0.69 GSE51057, d=+0.22 GSE51032; null permutation p=0.016)
cross_disease_universal_alarm.engine_role: Stage 4.5 bidirectional decomposition runs every patient runtime — pooled cancellation does not hide bidirectional firing in v2.0 reporting

bidirectional_immune_decomposition.description: AIBL d_up=+0.494 / d_down=-0.515 in AD (opposite signs strongly fire); per-CpG concordance 7/7 with VAL-051 panel. Breast pre-dx fires DOWN only (d_down=-0.56, d_up=-0.14) — disease-specific bidirectional firing.

trajectory_intensification_signature.description: When a customer's immune A-score intensifies across serial samples (vs stable or resolving), the trajectory itself is the diagnostic signal — not the single reading. The framework's primary clinical use mode is trajectory monitoring against the patient's own baseline.

homeostasis_quality_indicators.doctrine: How well-tuned is the immune system? These metrics describe homeostasis quality beyond simple disease detection.
homeostasis_quality_indicators.narrow_per_cell_CI_low_signal_variance: Patient with narrow per-cell A-score CIs + low variance across the 19-cell fanout indicates well-calibrated immune compartment — even if some cells show elevation, the COHERENCE of the pattern is reassuring
homeostasis_quality_indicators.broad_per_cell_CI_high_signal_variance: Wide per-cell CIs + high variance indicates immune compartment in flux — could be acute recovery, immunosuppression transition, or pre-clinical disease drift starting; trajectory monitoring is the discriminator
homeostasis_quality_indicators.low_mahalanobis_high_per_cell_signal: Mahalanobis low + per-cell elevations present indicates the elevations are concordant with healthy variation across the n=2,481 HC hull — interesting but not concerning
homeostasis_quality_indicators.high_mahalanobis_low_per_cell_signal: Mahalanobis high without specific per-cell elevations indicates the patient's immune profile is in an unusual region of HC-space — investigate for unmeasured covariate (recent vaccination, recent illness, undeclared medication)

CPG-VAL-014.title: AD-GIFT tauopathy specificity arm — AD vs FTD vs PSP/CBD vs HC Mahalanobis hyper-volume
CPG-VAL-014.cohort: GSE53740 GIFT (n_AD=15, n_FTD=121, n_FTD-MND=7, n_PSP=43, n_CBD=1, n_HC=193, 450K platform)
CPG-VAL-014.primary_origin_card: AD-immune card v3.1 (where CPG-VAL-014 is the canonical evidence anchor for FTD/PSP post_build_GIFT_2026 disease matrix rows)
CPG-VAL-014.why_included_here: Mahalanobis hyper-volume is computed on the 115-cell A-score space (29 of 115 columns are immune-class); the tauopathy differential is immune-class-relevant because it demonstrates the Mahalanobis metric's discriminative capacity across distinct neurodegenerative subtypes. The immune-atlas card's Stage 5 Mahalanobis is the same metric.
headline_findings: AD vs HC: Mahalanobis d=+0.681 (N1 null permutation p=0.037) — third independent cross-platform AD anchor after AIBL (d=+0.20) and AddNeuroMed (d=-0.006)

PSP/CBD vs HC: Mahalanobis d=-0.380 (N1 null permutation p=0.034) — DIRECTION IS NEGATIVE (architectural compaction BELOW HC centroid); confirms BELOW_NORMAL tier directly via universal hyper-volume metric
FTD vs HC: Mahalanobis d=+0.279 (p=0.108, non-significant); intermediate between AD positive and PSP negative
PSP+CBD combined: d=-0.378 (p=3.0e-6 highly significant)
Three-direction tauopathy differential established: AD positive / FTD intermediate / PSP negative

CPG-VAL-015.what: Aging trajectory — immune cellular age + immune A-score vs chronological age
CPG-VAL-015.cohort: GSE40279 Hannum n=656 healthy whole blood ages 19–101

CPG-VAL-016.title: Cross-disease universal alarm via A_immune
CPG-VAL-016.cohorts: AIBL AD + GSE51057 breast + GSE51032 breast (canonical 115-cell A-scores)
headline_findings: A_immune fires in BOTH AD (d=-0.364, p<0.001) and breast pre-dx (d=+0.688 GSE51057; d=+0.217 GSE51032)
Direction is DISEASE-SPECIFIC: AD hypomethylates, breast hypermethylates
In AIBL, A_immune is the STRONGEST signal (stronger than 7/7 other classes)
In breast cohorts, A_immune is one of several signals (cycling/progenitor outrank it)
Pre-registered Pass-3 (fixed-effect meta) FAILS due to sign-opposition — informative, not adverse
Null test (1000 arm shuffles): observed effect distinguishable from noise (p=0.016)
CPG-VAL-016.note: DIRECTIONAL outcome reflects pre-registration choice. The substantive claim (universal alarm fires across diseases with disease-specific direction) is fully supported. Pass-3 (fixed-effects meta) was the wrong test for sign-heterogeneous effects.

CPG-VAL-017.title: Inflammaging in pooled hull HC
CPG-VAL-017.cohorts: Hannum + Han Chinese + Tsaprouni + GSE51057 HC + GSE51032 HC (n=1,763 pooled)
headline_findings: Pooled A_immune-vs-age r = +0.034 (Pass-1 FAILS) due to cohort-recruitment heterogeneity
General-population cohorts go negative as predicted: Hannum r=-0.197, Han Chinese r=-0.142, Tsaprouni r=-0.056
Case-control HC arms go POSITIVE: GSE51057 r=+0.210, GSE51032 r=+0.061 — survivor selection effect
Late-life acceleration ratio (Pass-3): 2.19 (post-70 slope 2.2x steeper than pre-50, in opposite direction)
Pooled decade-medians show late-life-specific decline (60s peak 0.792, 80s 0.766) — inflammaging signature detected without linear pooled test
Null test confirms pooled regression is washed by cohort heterogeneity (p=1.00 vs cohort-stratified shuffle)
CPG-VAL-017.lessons: Pooled fixed-effects regression is the wrong test when cohorts have heterogeneous recruitment frames. The signal IS detectable in decade-medians + per-cohort breakdown + within-cohort acceleration analysis. Future VAL-017_v2 should use mixed-effects with cohort random effect.
CPG-VAL-017.note: NULL outcome by strict PREREG; substantive late-life-decline signal IS present and Pass-3 IS met. The cohort-heterogeneity finding is itself informative for the card's recruitment-frame guidance.

CPG-VAL-018.title: Menarche-age effect on female immune architecture (pivoted from HRT scope)
CPG-VAL-018.cohorts: GSE51057 (n=177) + GSE51032 (n=336) = 513 HC women pooled with menarche metadata
CPG-VAL-018.scope_pivot_note: Pivoted from HRT (field not in available cohort metadata) to menarche-age (cleaner natural-experiment variable available in both cohorts). Pivot documented in SCOPE_PIVOT_AUDIT.md.
headline_findings: Pooled partial r(menarche, A_immune | age + cohort) = +0.010, p=0.82 — clean null
Per-cohort: GSE51057 +0.022 (p=0.77), GSE51032 +0.003 (p=0.96) — signs concur but magnitudes negligible
ALL 8 classes show partial r between -0.05 and +0.04 — no class-specific menarche signature
Magnitude: +0.0002 A_immune per menarche-year (10x below the pre-registered threshold of 0.002)
Null test: observed indistinguishable from cohort-stratified shuffle (p=0.82)
HONEST NEGATIVE: menarche-age operationalization fails. Framework's broader reproductive-endocrinology claim is NOT falsified — only this specific proxy is.
CPG-VAL-018.lessons: Menarche-age range restriction (9-17) and adult-age sampling (34-72) limit power to detect a signal that may exist with extreme cases or longitudinal peri-menopausal tracking. Future v1.1 extension should prioritize HRT-stratified or peri-menopausal cohorts over historical-timing proxies.

CPG-VAL-022.title: Lifestyle reversibility via smoking cessation (Tsaprouni)
CPG-VAL-022.cohort: GSE50660 Tsaprouni 2014 (UK, HM450, whole blood) — never 179, former 263, current 22
headline_findings: Smoking effect d(current-never)=+0.11 p=0.65 — BELOW detection threshold (cohort underpowered with n=22 current)
Former smokers OVERSHOOT (mean 0.831) past current (0.828) past never (0.825) — NOT intermediate as simple reversibility predicts
Pattern consistent with literature on persistent post-cessation inflammation (Annibali 2019, van der Plaat 2018)
Only stem_adult class shows true reversibility (ratio 0.66) — per-class diagnostic finding
Cohort-limitation NULL, NOT framework falsification — proper test needs longitudinal pre/post with quit-duration metadata
CPG-VAL-022.lessons: Cross-sectional cohorts with status-only metadata cannot resolve reversibility — need longitudinal pre/post. Healthy-adult cohorts are pre-filtered for successful-survivor selection effects. VAL-021 (weight-loss) will need a proper pre/post bariatric cohort, not cross-sectional weight history.

This is the natural clinical workflow: baseline + post-intervention re-measurement.
